mapper.select: SELECT id, node_id AS nodeId, component, fault_name AS faultName, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime FROM config_resume_fault_data WHERE node_id = #{nodeId} AND start_time > #{startTime} AND start_time < #{endTime} OR node_id = #{nodeId} AND end_time > #{startTime} AND end_time < #{endTime}
